personality: 8 Hand-Drawn warmth fused with 4 Tactile pill shapes
personality_one_liner: A warm, deeply calming, and softly structured experience focused on organic shapes, sunrise tones, and tactile pill-shaped components.

spacing.rule: Generous and airy spacing, letting soft shapes breathe. Cards should never touch screen edges.

do's: Use glassy overlays on warm beige backgrounds for depth
Apply to sticky headers, tab bars, and the translucent part of the Join Now pill button
Keep the blur soft to preserve the airy feel
dont's: Don't blur forms or dense body text
Don't stack multiple layers of glassmorphism

screens.name: Hero/Onboarding
screens.purpose: Introduce the app visually with a warm sunrise and a prominent, split-pill CTA.
screens.layout: Full-bleed hero image with vertical gradient scrim at the bottom (transparent to surfaceInverse). Small 'Bliss App' label above large stacked display title 'Discover a new world of wellness and serenity' in bottom-left. Sticky bottom right-aligned split-pill 'Join Now' CTA: Left side is a white circular button with right-arrow (using border radius 999), right side is a translucent dark pill holding the text 'Join Now >>>'.

screens.name: Student Profile / Plan
screens.purpose: A calm dashboard greeting the student and showing upcoming structured sessions.

states.loading: Skeleton cards with soft rounded edges.
states.empty: Illustration of a singing bowl, 'No plan active', 'Browse events' pill CTA.
states.error: Failed to load plan, 'Tap to retry'.

screens.layout: Glassy warm beige background (surface). Top header with circular avatar (left) and 3-dots menu (right). Warm greeting 'Hello, [Name] 😊' (muted) above large title 'Your healthy training plan is ready'. An 'Add to Calendar' pill button (dark/brandPrimary) next to overlapping avatars. Below: Soft white rounded (lg: 24) horizontal cards showing classes ('Yoga 45 min', 'Breath 15 min') with tiny monoline icons. Full width 'Meditation' card at the bottom.

screens.name: Events Calendar
screens.purpose: Explore available active events using a soft grid and featured card.

states.loading: Skeleton calendar grid and skeleton featured card.
states.empty: No events this month, generic empty illustration.

screens.layout: Glassy warm beige background. Top avatar + dots menu header. Large 'My Calendar' title. Filter row: Month pill ('April' + icon), dark active pill ('All'), faded pill ('Yoga'). Calendar grid: Mon-Sun headers, day numbers inside individual rounded-square cells (md: 16). Selected/Active days filled with brandPrimary (dark ink), inactive days surfaceSecondary (white). Below grid: Large featured next-event card (lg: 24 radius). Content: large photo on the right half, left half displays bold time, location 'Flower Yoga Studio', and 'Trainer' label, overlaid with gradient scrim if needed.

instructions_to_main_agent: Map the JSON tokens to the existing Sound Healing Greece tokens: 'champagne/sand' mapping to 'surface' for light mode, 'white' for 'surfaceSecondary', and 'ink' for 'brandPrimary'. Ensure dark mode logic inverses these to maintain readability.

Implement the 'Join Now' CTA as a split pill. It requires a Flex row container with pill-radius (999). Left element is a pure white circle containing a right arrow, right element is a translucent dark background with the text. Adjust flexbox padding to make them align perfectly.
The Events calendar must use individual rounded cells for dates. Active dates should have a background of 'brandPrimary' (dark ink in light mode, soft sand in dark mode).
Card shapes should enforce the 24px/32px large corner radii per the user's request. Avoid sharp corners on these screens.
Do not invent new fonts. The app strictly uses 'Raleway' as requested.
Remember to implement the mandatory gradient-to-dark scrim pattern whenever text overlays the full-bleed hero image or the featured event photo.
